title: Sound Physics 1.7.10 Mixin Edition
description: Fork of the 1.7.10 Sound Physics mod with lwjgl3ify compat.
body:
A Minecraft mod that provides realistic sound attenuation, reverberation, and absorption through blocks.

This is a fork of a fork of a fork! I forked it from djpadbit,who forked it from daipenger who forked it from sonicether, daipenger ported it to 1.12.2 and updated the mod, djpadbit added some stuff.

This fork fixes compatability with lwjgl3ify and moves most of the 1.7.10 asm into mixins. **I am not planning on maintaining this fork but feel free to use it**.

Djpadbit fork info:

    Dynamic environment evaluation (disabled by default, enable in mod config ingame)
    Automatic stereo to mono down-mixing of sounds
    More compatibility with mods (for now only computronics)
